messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert: prefix-cache miss-rate spike > 12% in production (us-west) - firing paging runbooks
Maria: seeing customer errors 502/504 and slow tail latency on text-gen routes.
Maria: top-level symptom: request latency climb from 120ms -> 1.2s and cache hit-rate drop from 88% -> 36% in 5m window.
Ryan: I'm on logs. initial hypothesis: KV prefix namespace churn + unexpected TTL tombstones after deployment.
Sam: grabbing logs and tailing cache proxy now. running:
Sam: ```bash
rinfra logs tail service/cache-proxy --env prod --filter "prefix=txt-gen" --since 10m
```
Sam: sample from proxy (truncated):
Sam: ```
[2026-03-15T22:10:11Z] GET /v1/txt-gen req_id=abc123 key=prefix:usr:42 miss
[2026-03-15T22:10:11Z] FETCH kv-store key=prefix:usr:42 err=NOT_FOUND
[2026-03-15T22:10:12Z] EVICT key=prefix:usr:42 reason=ttl_expired
[2026-03-15T22:10:13Z] GET /v1/txt-gen req_id=def456 key=prefix:usr:42 miss
[2026-03-15T22:10:13Z] FETCH kv-store key=prefix:usr:42 hit=stale_version
```
Liz: I can see correlated spikes on paging metrics. paging_count per node jumped 4x at 22:09:30.
Maria: customer impact: several enterprise tenants reported timeout spikes, fronted by support. working on a service message.
Carol: drafting comms. need a short impact summary + ETA to mitigation.
Aj: mitigation plan: 1) bump cache TTL from 10m -> 2h for affected prefix, 2) temporarily disable eviction compaction job, 3) scale dedicated cache nodes + route-read fallback.
Aj: applying TTL change now with patch:
Aj: ```json
{"patch": {"prefix_filter": "prefix:usr:*", "ttl_seconds": 7200}}
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: config/ttl-change by Aj (run id 69123)
deploy-bot: deploy success in 48s
Maria: after TTL bump we see hit-rate recover to 75% within ~3m. errors drop but still elevated on tail.
Ryan: correlating with a recent model rollout? checking model version tags.
Ryan: ```log
[2026-03-15T22:06:50Z] model-deploy: txt-gen:v3 -> v4 partial rollout 20%
[2026-03-15T22:08:40Z] model-deploy: txt-gen:v4 traffic scaled to 100%
```
Sam: that aligns: v4's signature changed cache key hashing (minor bug) which caused mismatched keys and duplicate namespace entries, leading to effective cache erosion.
Maria: tl;dr: model rollout changed key salt -> prefixes diverged -> cache reuse went down -> eviction and paging increased.
Liz: building a timeline to include in RCA. current timeline events (compact):
Liz: - 22:05:43 model rollout started (v3->v4)
Liz: - 22:08:40 rollout completed
Liz: - 22:09:15 cache miss spike observed
Liz: - 22:10:02 paging spike, 4x
Liz: - 22:13:00 TTL bump applied
Liz: - 22:16:30 hit-rate partial recovery
Aj: can someone save the full raw logs and upload to the incident bucket? use the runbook script:
Aj: ```bash
rinfra runbook collect-incident-logs --incident-id=INC-2026-0315-01 --targets cache-proxy,kv-store,router --since 22:00
```
Sam: uploaded tarball to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0315-01/logs.tar.gz
Sam: ```link
https://s3.redwood.com/INC-2026-0315-01/logs.tar.gz
```
Maria: handing over on-call to Aj for deep RCA analysis. I'm going to support customer comms.
Maria: @Aj you're owning follow-ups: timeline, root cause writeup, mitigation plan for avoiding key-salt regressions.
Aj: taking it. first cut hypothesis: model packaging changed cache salt variable -> keys mismatch. root cause likely ci artifact not including cache compatibility test.
Ryan: tasks to close:
Ryan: - add cache-key compatibility test to model-deploy pipeline
Ryan: - add pre-rollout smoke to verify hit-rate doesn't drop >5%
Ryan: - formalize TTL safety net for sudden hit-rate drops
Carol: I'll own customer postmortem + status update. plan to send initial update in 30m.
Maria: quick note: please annotate timeline with exact node ids and any rewarm ops. we need numbers for cost impact too.
Aj: will run a rewarm job to rehydrate hot prefixes after RCAs. scheduling in 1h.
Sam: low-priority: add metric to detect 'prefix entropy' — sudden growth in unique prefix keys per minute.
Liz: adding to RCA doc draft: https://docs.redwood.com/incident/inc-2026-0315-01 (will populate)
Maria: thanks all. leaving thread — @Aj ping me if you need help.
Aj: ack. starting detailed analysis now.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0315-01 status -> MITIGATED (partial) | owner=Aj | severity=SEV-2
